name: 3xP Global
position: 3xP Global is a Lisbon-based investor that gets deeply involved in the companies it backs, combining ESG principles with long-term value creation. It invests through an Impact Innovation Fund, a Health Innovation Fund, the SIF Innovation Fund and a Responsible AI Fund, almost entirely in Portuguese companies.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your hands-on model is exactly how I like to work, and several of your companies, from Biometrid and Leadzai to Granter and Intuitivo, sit right on top of what I've built.
summary: 3xP Global doesn't just invest, it gets involved, and the involvement that pays off fastest in an early company is usually product and revenue. I've spent nine years on both: AI-powered KYC and biometric onboarding at 14M-user scale, ad tech on both sides of the market, and customer and revenue operations for a New York ad platform. Your identity, adtech and AI companies, plus the Responsible AI Fund's portfolio, are where I'd add value first, from Lisbon and alongside your team.

reasons.title: Biometric identity, done at scale
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network: ID capture, liveness checks, human review and fraud for 14M+ users. That's Biometrid's market.

reasons.title: Responsible AI is a product discipline
reasons.body: I've shipped LLM features with evaluation sets and production guardrails. That's what Leadzai, LoopOS, PeekMed and Granter need as AI moves into production.

reasons.title: Built for hands-on investors
reasons.body: You're deeply involved with your founders. I can be the embedded product or RevOps lead who turns that involvement into shipped work, freelance or full-time.

vc_notes.thesis: Health and impact dominate; the SIF and Responsible AI funds hold my strongest matches.
vc_notes.stage: Stage isn't stated; the portfolio mixes early-stage startups and growing companies.
vc_notes.platform: A deliberately hands-on, deeply involved model.
